description: The bar chart illustrates model scores across multiple benchmarks, showing three model variants for each benchmark category. The horizontal axis contains the benchmark categories labeled “MathVista,” “MathVerse,” an unlabeled third benchmark (shown as a blank/gray label area), and “Physics,” arranged left to right in that order; the axis label is “Benchmark.” The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Score,” using a linear scale ranging from 35 to 80 with regularly spaced tick marks at 5-point intervals. For each benchmark, there is a grouped set of three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend in the upper-right: SRPO-7B (dark navy), GRPO-7B (medium blue), and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B (light blue). In MathVista, the bars are labeled approximately 75.8 (SRPO-7B), 72.3 (GRPO-7B), and 68.2 (Qwen-2.5-VL-7B). In MathVerse, the bars are about 55.8 (SRPO-7B), 52.9 (GRPO-7B), and 46.3 (Qwen-2.5-VL-7B). In the unlabeled third benchmark group, the bars are about 42.3 (SRPO-7B), 39.9 (GRPO-7B), and 36.9 (Qwen-2.5-VL-7B). In Physics, the bars are about 60.6 (SRPO-7B), 53.5 (GRPO-7B), and 45.4 (Qwen-2.5-VL-7B). The bars are grouped by benchmark rather than sorted by value, and each bar has a numeric value annotation above it; no additional visual emphasis (such as outlines or shading beyond the color scheme) is present.
